method: Unchanged WorldGenMinable.generate and BiomeDecorator.generateOres with native constructor configuration and helpers. World double supplies original-ID block reads and writes (metadata and flags recorded), Y 0..255 and +/-30M bounds; solid and mixed fixtures plus native terrain/surface/cave/ravine chunks. Every candidate read coordinate is hashed as three little-endian int32s, every write is recorded in order. Wrappers record native ore attempts without drawing Random. The full populate invocation order is separately inspected with javap, including conditional structures/lakes, dungeons, biome decoration, spawning and ice/snow; invocation listings are not execution of those branches. Population seed records execute ChunkProviderGenerate.populate only through its second Random.setSeed, then stop before any features. No full population, native World/Chunk notifications or integrated runtime acceptance. Natural ore-pass Random is deliberately seeded to 1234, not claimed to be the post-lake/dungeon stream. JVM 19.0.1.
